expected_facts: Fits start at peak rate, excluding the 2-3 month cleanup ramp
Shut-in (zero) months are excluded from fitting but counted in cumulative production
Downtime months are handled by a stated rate basis (producing-day rates using days_on)
b is bounded and a terminal decline is applied (or the agent asks for both)
EUR = cumulative to date + forecast to a stated economic limit / max life
guidelines: Ask the user for b-bounds, terminal decline, economic limit and life rather than choosing silently

Two wells with missing lateral length are excluded and named, not imputed silently
Rates/EURs are scaled by 10,000 ft / lateral_ft (normalization stated)
Months with too few wells are truncated to avoid survivor bias
guidelines: P10 >= P50 >= P90 everywhere in the output

guidelines: List every excluded period with its reason
